title: The Informer (FCP 2026)
synopsis: The Paris police are desperate to bust drug kingpin Roger Massina. To do it, they want pimp Dede Laffont to serve as their inside man (known as la balance in French). Dede refuses: Informants never live very long. But Detective Palouzi isn't taking no for an answer. Sure enough, the police put pressure on Nicole Danet, the prostitute who's also Dede's girlfriend, forcing him to make a decision that could rob him of everything.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 巴黎警方急於搗破毒梟Roger Massina。為了成事，他們想找皮條客Dede Laffont充當線人，然而Dede拒絕了，因為線人從來不長命。可是警長Palouzi並不罷休，因而決定向妓女Nicole Danet施壓，她也是Dede的女友，以此逼Dede作出一個可能令他失去一切的決定。
